scope: future formal G1 only; all qualification and rehearsal runs are excluded
preregistration_sha256_basis: canonical UTF-8 JSON with preregistration_sha256 and preregistration_sha256_basis removed, sorted keys, and compact separators

reporting.worst_n_definition: pre-registered N from the Level-A metric contract; no posthoc N selection

paired_effect_analysis.unit: same valid_iid sample under Full and each registered ablation and seed
paired_effect_analysis.effect_direction: positive means ablation_error - Full_error; negative favors ablation
paired_effect_analysis.primary_summary: paired per-sample effect mean and median with per-seed and pooled summaries

claim_rules.superiority: A directional claim requires the paired 95% CI for the pre-registered effect to exclude zero, the median paired effect to have the same direction, and the direction to be consistent in all three seeds
claim_rules.noninferiority: A noninferiority claim requires a pre-registered margin in the applicable gate contract and the paired 95% CI to remain within that margin; no margin may be introduced after results
claim_rules.descriptive_only: If an interval includes zero or seed directions disagree, report the effect descriptively and do not make a superiority claim
claim_rules.p_values: n=3 seed p-values are not primary evidence and are not used as the acceptance rule

future_evidence_roles.budget_qualification: nonpublication qualification only; excluded from formal G1 statistics
future_evidence_roles.formal_g1: the only publication-eligible role after all gates are explicitly open
